description: The portfolio's Renovate configuration lives in sborka and is extended by name. What was here before was `config:recommended` and nothing else, which is why this repository has been taking one sborka release as two pull requests — #5 (`plugin ru.workinprogress.sborka.settings`) and #7 (`sborka`), both 0.2.0.30, neither mentioning the other. The version is named in two places, settings.gradle.kts and the catalog, and only a grouping rule makes them one change.
The preset also refuses `kotlinx-datetime:*-0.6.x-compat`, which is 0.8.0 built against the OLD 0.6.x API. #8 is offering exactly that right now.

sborka's `automerge-harness` is extended second, so `github-actions` and `gradle-wrapper` updates merge themselves on green — with one exception below. The precondition holds, re-checked 2026-11-25: `check.yaml` runs the build, the conformance suite, the chart and the e2e on every `pull_request`. The exception is `publish-image.yaml`, which runs on a tag: `docker/login-action` is used there and by no pull request, so it waits for a person.

The actions that only `publish-image.yaml` uses wait for a person: that workflow runs on a tag (or by hand), no pull request runs it, so a green pull request says nothing about them and a broken one would surface at the next release, not on the merge. Every other action and the wrapper merge themselves through `automerge-harness`, because the pull-request workflows ran exactly those versions.

AFTER the presets, because the last match wins, and in a group of its own: Renovate merges a grouped pull request only when every update in it may merge, so left in `ci actions` these would hold every other action with them. The list is what that workflow uses and no pull-request workflow does (re-checked 2026-11-25); an action added to that workflow later is not on it until somebody adds it here.
